title: Charles H. Mayone, Jr. | Obituaries | timesargus.com
text:
Charles H. Mayone, Jr. MONTPELIER — Charles Henry Mayone, Jr., passed peacefully with his family present on October 3, 2026, after a battle with lymphoma. He was 96 yrs old. A Mass of Christian Burial will be celebrated in Charlie’s honor at St. Augustine’s Church in Montpelier on Saturday, November 7th at 11 a.m. Charlie’s ashes will be interred alongside his beloved wife in the South Fayston Cemetery. Arrangements are in the care of Guare & Sons Funeral Home. To view a complete obituary or share online condolences, please visit www.guareandsons.com.
